【DJ Live Streaming vol.10   “PEACE”】

Love is everywhere. Connected by music, united by love.

This time, we're sharing a transition scene from "Elins Blue Eyes – Bo Axelzon & His Exotic Sounds" into "Journey To The East – Bill Plummer And The Cosmic Brotherhood".

Enjoy the transition from exotic rare grooves with undulating sitar and various acoustics to psychedelic sitar jazz with the scent of Indian music.
